cs.t: Getting an active sitting chair is great if you fidget too. I bought an Ariel from  https://qor360.com/  at the begging of the pandemic and I love it. It's an unstable stool so your body can always be in motion. Office chairs had always given me back pain but it went away with this chair (+yoga and a better mattress). The seat is very firm, however. It took a while to adjust to.
